notes.title: V0.2 Update
notes.content:
V0.2 Update
1- Inventory clearing system implemented. [Content]
2- Item dropping algorithm improved. [Bug Fix]
3- Item panel is now much smoother to view. [Bug Fix]
4- Sometimes items that equipped and unequipped can break the player's stats, that eliminates whole gameplay. This problem is fixed now. [Major Bug Fix]

notes.title: V0.1.1 Update Released
notes.content:
V0.1.1 Update Released.

Updates:
- Collecting items from the ground has been made easier.
- The panel showing the properties of items in the inventory has been made easier to view.
- The number of items dropped from NPCs has been adjusted according to the NPC's level.
- Added the ability to zoom in and out the camera with the middle mouse button.

Feedback from you is extremely important during the development phase of the game. Thanks to your suggestions, the game can be developed more easily.
Regards.

Special thanks to "GAME GOD FLUENT".
